description: IObit Driver Booster 中文版是一款驱动管理工具，支持驱动检测、更新、备份和设备问题修复。
pre_uninstall: if ($running) { throw 'Close IObit Driver Booster and its portable launcher before updating or uninstalling so the launcher can save its data.' }
notes: This is a modified third-party Pro portable build, not an official IObit release.

The portable launcher requires Administrator elevation and temporarily moves IObit folders from ProgramData, Roaming and LocalLow while running. Avoid running it alongside other IObit software and close it normally before updating or uninstalling.
Launch DriverBoosterPortable.exe via the shortcut; the launcher moves settings into Data after the app exits. The raw App\Driver Booster\DriverBooster.exe bypasses that data handling.
The source bucket currently distributes version 13.1.0.171; the publisher now offers a different single-file package, which this manifest does not automatically migrate to.
